subGroup: Return from a Break In Learning
description: Creates a 1-year apprenticeship (2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30), then PUTs an update with a break in learning (pause 2025-02-01, resume 2025-05-31). Learner completes 12 days after resuming (2025-06-12), which is below the 42-day qualifying period.
